mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, room_id, seat_id, room_name_snapshot, seat_code_snapshot, start_at, end_at, status, rule_version_id, rule_snapshot, checkin_due_at, cancel_due_at, check_in_at, last_leave_at, leave_due_at, finished_at, leave_count, termination_reason, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('RESERVED', 'IN_USE', 'LEFT_TEMP') ORDER BY start_at
SELECT FROM reservation WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} AND status IN ('RESERVED', 'IN_USE', 'LEFT_TEMP') ORDER BY start_at

SELECT r.id, r.order_no, r.user_id, r.room_id, r.seat_id, r.room_name_snapshot, r.seat_code_snapshot, r.start_at, r.end_at, r.status, r.rule_version_id, r.rule_snapshot, r.checkin_due_at, r.cancel_due_at, r.check_in_at, r.last_leave_at, r.leave_due_at, r.finished_at, r.leave_count, r.termination_reason, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reservation r JOIN seat s ON s.id = r.seat_id WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'IN_USE', 'LEFT_TEMP') ORDER BY r.start_at, r.id

SELECT FROM reservation WHERE (status = 'RESERVED' AND (checkin_due_at <= #{now} OR end_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'IN_USE' AND end_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'LEFT_TEMP' AND ((leave_due_at IS NOT NULL AND leave_due_at <= #{now}) OR end_at <= #{now})) ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'RESERVED' THEN LEAST(checkin_due_at, end_at) WHEN 'LEFT_TEMP' THEN LEAST(COALESCE(leave_due_at, end_at), end_at) ELSE end_at END, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE start_at >= #{date} AND start_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status <> 'CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reservation WHERE start_at >= #{date} AND start_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status <> 'CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE start_at >= #{date} AND start_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status = 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (order_no, user_id, room_id, seat_id, room_name_snapshot, seat_code_snapshot, start_at, end_at, status, rule_version_id, rule_snapshot, checkin_due_at, cancel_due_at, check_in_at, last_leave_at, leave_due_at, finished_at, leave_count, termination_reason, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{seatId}, #{roomNameSnapshot}, #{seatCodeSnapshot}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status}, #{ruleVersionId}, #{ruleSnapshot}, #{checkinDueAt}, #{cancelDueAt}, #{checkInAt}, #{lastLeaveAt}, #{leaveDueAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{leaveCount}, #{terminationReason}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = #{status}, check_in_at = #{checkInAt}, last_leave_at = #{lastLeaveAt}, leave_due_at = #{leaveDueAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, leave_count = #{leaveCount}, termination_reason = #{terminationReason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
